items.summary: Giannis Antetokounmpo has entered a new chapter in his career, joining the Miami Heat after 13 years and one NBA championship with the Milwaukee Bucks. Despite acknowledging the necessity of this next chapter with the Heat, Antetokounmpo expressed hope that he might one day return to Milwaukee, "if they would have me.""I love the city of Milwaukee," he said. items.title: YouTube Gold: 1964 Game 7 Western Conference Finals With Three Brilliant Talents
items.summary: Mar 29, 1961; Los Angeles, CA, USA: FILE PHOTO; St. Louis Hawks forward Bob Pettit (9) in action against the Los Angeles Lakers during the 1961 playoffs at the L.A. Sports Arena. Mandatory Credit: Darryl Norenberg-Imagn Images Network This is some pretty rare video from 1964, of a Game 7 between the (then) St. Louis Hawks and the (then) San Francisco Warriors. There are at least three Hall of Famers in this game: Wilt Chamberlain and Nate Thurmond for the Warriors, and Bob Pettit for the Hawks. San Francisco started both Chamberlain, who was 7-1 and 27, and Thurmond, who was 6-11 and 22, and that was unusual in that era. However, both were supremely athletic, and that allowed the Warriors to play both at the same time. Pettit at that point was 31 and nearing the end of his career.
